name: cocos-creator
description: Cocos Creator is a cross-platform 2D & 3D game engine written in C++ and TypeScript, licensed under MIT.

scripts.postinstall: npm run build:debug-infos && npm run build:declaration && npm run build:adapter && npm run build:native-pack-tool
scripts.build: npm run build:min && npm run build:declaration
scripts.build:native-pack-tool: cd ./scripts/native-pack-tool && npm install && npm run build
scripts.vite:dev:web: cross-env VITE_PLATFORM=web vite build --config vite/config/vite.config.ts --mode development
scripts.vite:build:web: cross-env VITE_PLATFORM=web vite build --config vite/config/vite.config.ts --mode production
scripts.vite:dev:wechat: cross-env VITE_PLATFORM=wechat vite build --config vite/config/vite.config.ts --mode development
scripts.vite:build:wechat: cross-env VITE_PLATFORM=wechat vite build --config vite/config/vite.config.ts --mode production
scripts.vite:dev:xiaomi: cross-env VITE_PLATFORM=xiaomi vite build --config vite/config/vite.config.ts --mode development
scripts.vite:build:xiaomi: cross-env VITE_PLATFORM=xiaomi vite build --config vite/config/vite.config.ts --mode production
scripts.vite:dev:alipay: cross-env VITE_PLATFORM=alipay vite build --config vite/config/vite.config.ts --mode development
scripts.vite:build:alipay: cross-env VITE_PLATFORM=alipay vite build --config vite/config/vite.config.ts --mode production
scripts.vite:dev:bytedance: cross-env VITE_PLATFORM=bytedance vite build --config vite/config/vite.config.ts --mode development
scripts.vite:build:bytedance: cross-env VITE_PLATFORM=bytedance vite build --config vite/config/vite.config.ts --mode production
scripts.vite:dev:baidu: cross-env VITE_PLATFORM=baidu vite build --config vite/config/vite.config.ts --mode development
scripts.vite:build:baidu: cross-env VITE_PLATFORM=baidu vite build --config vite/config/vite.config.ts --mode production
scripts.vite:dev:native: cross-env VITE_PLATFORM=native vite build --config vite/config/vite.config.ts --mode development
scripts.vite:build:native: cross-env VITE_PLATFORM=native vite build --config vite/config/vite.config.ts --mode production
scripts.vite:build:all: npm run vite:build:web && npm run vite:build:wechat && npm run vite:build:xiaomi && npm run vite:build:alipay && npm run vite:build:bytedance && npm run vite:build:baidu
